_mode_note: mock = pipeline jalan penuh tanpa API real. live = pakai credentials asli

tiktok._note: daftar di developers.tiktok.com -> Create app -> scope video.upload + video.publish. Jalankan python3 get_tiktok_token.py buat dapat access_token. NOTE: app belum di-audit = video post PRIVATE dulu (SELF_ONLY). Setelah audit, baru PUBLIC.

tiktok_shop._note: TikTok Shop Affiliate: seller share video promo yang boleh creator repost. Video dari collaboration/seller = rights-cleared. Drop video ke folder inbox/ atau forward ke Telegram bot.

clipping._note: trim video ke max duration, re-encode vertikal 9:16 kalau perlu

posting._post_mode_options: api = post via Content Posting API (video PRIVATE kalau belum audit). hybrid = bot siapkan semua, lo post manual di app + attach product basket. description_only = post via API + link produk di caption.
